name: manage_script
description:
Manage user scripts as tools: action=register registers/updates, action=unregister removes.
For register, the script must already exist in the scripts directory; the call updates index.json, sets the executable bit, and the script becomes usable immediately in subsequent tool turns. unregister can optionally delete the file as well (only within the scripts directory).

id.description: Unique tool identifier (ASCII, starts with a letter); this is the function name the AI calls.

display_name.description: Human-readable display name; may contain Chinese.

description.description: Optional description override. When omitted, it is read from the Description:/描述： line in the script header.

path.description: register only: script file name or path within the scripts directory.

parameters.description: JSON schema for the tool's parameters. When omitted, a generic schema with stdin is used.

delete_file.description: unregister only: also delete the script file.
